core.title: Fernbrook flyer run and the kraft paper news
core.setting: Print shop manager at TrueType Print House, a commercial printing shop

events.text: Standing rule at TrueType Print House: once a delivery date has been confirmed with a client, it may only be moved with that client's written agreement. No exceptions without the client saying yes in writing.
Standing rule: any supplier order with a total over 800 must be signed off by our finance lead Priya Shah before it is placed. Orders of 800 or less can be placed directly.

Hi Marta, confirming Fernbrook Yoga Studio will keep ordering 500 A5 flyers each month from TrueType Print House. Deliveries should come to our studio at 14 Mill Lane, Bramford. I am the contact for anything about our print jobs.
Marta, just so you know for planning: the Heidelberg press is free every Friday morning between 09:00 and 12:00, so that is the best window for any bigger flyer runs.
Booked the Heidelberg press on Friday 16 October 2026 from 09:00 for the Fernbrook Yoga Studio run of 500 A5 flyers, using the free Friday morning window Tom flagged.
Hi Marta, our 130gsm silk paper is 42 per box, and we can deliver to your workshop on Station Road within three working days of any order.
Ordered 6 boxes of 130gsm silk paper from Papermill Direct at 42 per box, total 252, for the autumn flyer work. That is well under the 800 threshold, so no sign-off from Priya was needed.
Scheduled the delivery of the Fernbrook Yoga Studio flyers for 20 October 2026 to 14 Mill Lane, Bramford, in the shop van, four days after the press run on 16 October.
Thanks Marta, the June flyers looked great. The studio newsletter goes out the week after delivery as usual, so the October timing works well for us.
Nico confirmed the shop van comfortably holds up to 40 boxes of paper or the equivalent in packed flyers, so single-client deliveries are never a capacity problem.
Send the October flyer proof to Joeline Park at Fernbrook Yoga Studio for approval by 14 October 2026.
Assigned Tom Ellery as press operator for the Fernbrook flyer run on the Heidelberg press on 16 October 2026, since he knows that machine best.
Black and cyan ink levels are fine for the autumn work; magenta will want a top-up sometime in November but nothing urgent.
Added Fernbrook Yoga Studio to the client register with Joeline Park as contact and 14 Mill Lane, Bramford as the delivery address, since they are now a regular monthly client.
Just a note that our standard courier now does morning drops to Bramford on Tuesdays and Thursdays if you ever need paper sent onward rather than to your workshop.
Joeline called to say the October flyer artwork will be the same layout as September with new class times, and she will email the file over before the proof stage.
Hi Marta, the October artwork file is attached. Same 500 A5 flyers as usual please, delivery to 14 Mill Lane, Bramford as always.
Team catch-up: October is busy with the Fernbrook run, two restaurant menu jobs and the usual poster reprints. Tom to keep Friday mornings clear on the Heidelberg.

Hi Marta, exciting news from our mill: we are launching a recycled kraft paper line from November, and I have popped some sample swatches in the post to your Station Road workshop in case TrueType wants to try it for future jobs.
Following up on the kraft news: as a launch offer the recycled kraft will be 38 per box for orders placed in November, which is under our standard silk price.
Reminder that I am ready for the Fernbrook run on Friday morning; the silk paper from the June order is stacked by the press.
The Heidelberg press had its quarterly service on Thursday and is running cleanly, so Friday's slot is good to go.
